findings.title: HPESBNW05156 rev 1 / rev 2 - HPE Networking AOS-Switch advisory (Oct 6 2026)
findings.summary_md: HPE released HPESBNW05156 for AOS-Switch vulnerabilities; the bulletin directory index shows a 2026-10-06 timestamp. It covers multiple CVSS-critical flaws in AOS-S 16.11.0031 and earlier, including unauthenticated RCE pathways.

findings.title: Canadian Centre for Cyber Security AV26-1011 (Oct 7 2026)
findings.summary_md: CCCS published AV26-1011 on October 7, 2026 referencing HPE advisory HPESBNW05156 rev 1 for AOS-Switch and ClearPass Policy Manager. The alert urges administrators to apply updates for the affected networking products.

findings.title: Canadian Centre for Cyber Security AV26-1046 (Oct 15 2026)
findings.summary_md: CCCS updated AV26-1046 on October 15, 2026 referencing HPESBNW05156 rev 2 for AOS-Switch along with additional HPE product advisories. The bulletin lists AOS-S version 16.11.0031 and prior as affected.
